websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Websites to check, one per line. Domains (example.com) or full page URLs. Up to 5,000 per run.

includeDns.title: Check DNS records
includeDns.description: Also reads the domain's MX, TXT (SPF and domain verification), NS and SOA records. Reveals the e-mail provider, DNS host and SaaS tools the company verified its domain with (Salesforce, HubSpot, Atlassian...). Listed in the companyTools column.

includeDetails.title: Include technology details
includeDetails.description: Adds each technology's website, description, SaaS/open source flags, pricing tier and CPE id to the technologies list.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence (0-100)
minConfidence.description: Hide technologies detected with a lower confidence. Most detections are 100.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel websites
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to check at the same time.
